definitions.explanation: Soldiers who fight on foot, as opposed to cavalry or other mounted troops. Also refers to the infantry branch of a military force.

examples.japanese: {歩兵|ほへい}{部隊|ぶたい}が{前進|ぜんしん}した。
{戦場|せんじょう}では{歩兵|ほへい}が{最|もっと}も{多|おお}くの{犠牲|ぎせい}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: On the battlefield, the infantry suffered the most casualties.

examples.japanese: {近代|きんだい}の{戦争|せんそう}では、{歩兵|ほへい}の{役割|やくわり}は{大|おお}きく{変化|へんか}した。
examples.english: In modern warfare, the role of infantry has changed significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in military and historical contexts. In Japanese chess ({将棋|しょうぎ}), {歩兵|ふひょう} — note the different reading — refers to the pawn piece, commonly abbreviated to {歩|ふ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歩兵|ほへい}{部隊|ぶたい}: infantry unit
- {歩兵|ほへい}{連隊|れんたい}: infantry regiment
- {歩兵|ほへい}{師団|しだん}: infantry division
